explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/890: with ω_k(n) the number of distinct prime factors > k, is liminf_n Σ_{0≤i<k} ω_k(n+i) ≤ k for every k ≥ 1? The page explains this is the corrected form of [ErSe67]. omegaGt k n counts the prime factors > k, and the statement takes the liminf in EReal of the sum over range k and compares it to k. Faithful.
